messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment update: canary rw-infer-v3.1 -> 10% (regions: ap-south-1, eu-west-1). Since 1718223300 we see 4xx spike in eu-west (baseline 2.4% -> 8.7%). No auto-rollback triggered. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/canary/171822

maria: tagging @ops-oncall @li @kevin @sahil — should we HOLD the rollout? change window in ~2h so prefer quick decision.

kevin: I can repro locally with a small client: v3.1 removed trailing newline from streaming JSON frames; older clients expect newline-delimited frames and throw parse errors -> 4xx. Looks like compatibility regression.

li: ops-oncall here — logs also show intermittent KV cache growth and GC spikes on a subset of eu-west pods around the same time. Might be two issues coinciding.

sahil: if we pin region, how will product / release notes change? do customers need a heads-up?

maria: immediate plan: HOLD global rollout and pin eu-west back to v3.0.x to stop user impact. ops to run the pin, eng to prepare a patch and tests, product to draft comms.

kevin: pin command ready to run:
```
redwoodctl rollout pin --service=rw-infer --version=3.0.9 --regions=eu-west-1
```
This will route eu-west -> 3.0.9 immediately and keep other regions paused at canary.

ops-oncall: running pin now (executing redwoodctl). Will update with status.

deploy-bot: Action: pin started by ops-oncall at 1718223360. Change set: eu-west-1 => 100% @3.0.9. Canary global rollout paused. Track: https://dash.redwood/internal/rollouts/1718223360

li: watching metrics — 4xx rate in eu-west down to 2.6% within ~90s. KV GC also returning to baseline on the pinned pods.

maria: good signal. For the record: HOLD (final). @kevin please revert the newline behavior in v3.1 patch, add compatibility test for streaming clients. @sahil update release-notes: short blurb about regression + rollback and affected regions. Add CHG-rollback tag.

sahil: will post a single-paragraph note to #release-notes and update the release PR. Draft: "We observed a streaming compatibility regression in rw-infer v3.1 causing client parse errors in eu-west-1. We've pinned eu-west to v3.0.9 and paused the canary rollout while we prepare a fix." Will share link when posted.

kevin: root cause summary: removal of trailing newline in streaming frames + insufficient compatibility tests. Fix timeline: PR today, patch release tomorrow AM, re-run canary after tests.

maria: final checklist: 1) ops keep eu-west pinned (do not unpin) 2) kevin publish PR with tests 3) sahil publish notes + comms 4) li monitor for KV anomalies 5) reopen thread when canary resume decision is needed. HOLD. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: eu-west pin complete and stable. Leaving canary paused per request.

maria: thanks all, keeping this thread open until we have a patch + successful small-bake.
